description: The demo's 250 signs (the model's labels, in model order): the gloss shown in the app, plain English words for the offline sentence joiner, the slug of the external dictionary page (https://www.signasl.org/sign/<slug>, every slug checked to return videos on 2026-11-16) and a short handshape/motion reminder. Descriptions are reminders, not instruction; regional variants exist.
